info.name: Data NFTs API
info.description: The Data API provides web3 application developers with multi-chain data related to Avalanche's primary network, Avalanche subnets, and Ethereum.

variable.description: (Required) A supported evm chain id or blockchain id. Use the `/chains` endpoint to get a list of supported chain ids.
(Required) Contract address on the relevant chain.

request.description: Triggers reindexing of token metadata for an NFT token. Reindexing can only be called once per hour for each NFT token.
